creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found and verified 2026-10-24. After a pane is folded into a name and its daemon restarts, refetching the group replays Joined { pane }; cursor_from_join then calls make_addressed(pane), which creates the pane's participant again, holding the same pane as the name. by_pane returns whichever name sorts first, and pane ids sort before most names, so the pane can win. Happens on main after any fold followed by a restart.
title: A copy of a group refetched from scratch remakes a folded pane's participant
